finding: The former cross-lane methane density mixed incompatible numerators.
result: MSM/Futian used raw many-to-many annotation rows plus all HMM rows; POC used curated accepted/present features; MUCC used source DRAM terms.
report_action: Cross-lane methane/sulfur/substrate densities and the universal attestation ranking are quarantined. Raw annotation counts remain only as provenance diagnostics until the common accepted/present feature rebuild is complete.

finding: The quarantined score was materially coupled to pipeline-specific methane counts.
result: Pearson r=0.605; 99.4% of the legacy top 500 were mangrove rows.
report_action: Mangrove candidates are now selected by geometry and QC only, with no cross-lane mechanism rank.

finding: ESM-2 supports target-target neighborhood navigation, not rumen transfer.
result: Raw reciprocal unique pairs: 15,727 mangrove↔wetland, 1 rumen↔wetland, 0 mangrove↔rumen. After dimension z-scoring: 15,064, 0, 0, respectively.
report_action: Describe ESM-2 links as latent neighborhoods; forbid source-independent ecological or mechanism transfer claims.

finding: Bridge taxonomy is structured and GTDB release is source-confounded.
result: 79.2% of usable reciprocal mangrove↔wetland pairs match phylum after conservative synonym normalization; release metadata is absent outside POC.
